definitions.mercedes: Explicit subset: case-insensitive Mercedes, Benz, standalone AMG, obvious merceds typo, Arabic مرسيدس/مرسيدز/مرسدس/بنز. All 10 model-only query candidates were manually reviewed as Mercedes C63/E63/G63, C-Class chassis, G wagon or CLE references. Combined confirmed totals include these models; BRABUS ecosystem rows and unresolved mb vrx remain separate. Maybach-only queries are excluded as adjacent brand demand.
definitions.branded: Lexical site-brand segment: DIGI-TEC/digitecme and close spacing/hyphen/spelling variants including Digitech and ديجي تيك/ديجي تك. This is an analyst text classification, not proof of navigational intent; generic digi phrases and unresolved digitex/digitrch are excluded. Mercedes is vehicle brand, not a DIGI-TEC branded query.
definitions.position_bands: Continuous averages are grouped as <=3, >3 to <=10, >10 to <=20, >20. Labels 4-10 and 11-20 mean these continuous intervals, not rounded position integers.
definitions.ctr: Sum clicks / sum impressions. Exported CTR values are rounded and not averaged.
definitions.position: Sum(row average position * row impressions) / sum(row impressions); approximate due to two-decimal row position rounding. Query and page weighted averages are descriptive aggregates of exported rows, not identical to GSC property metric.

limitations: Current workbook is sitewide Web (text-based), Last 7 days; no query, page, country or device filters. Chart dates confirm 2026-10-18 through 2026-10-24 inclusive. Dubai is text in selected queries; results are not Dubai-local rank tracking.

Queries has 1000 rows, consistent with export row cap; anonymized and omitted query data make all-Mercedes totals lower-bound visible-export aggregates. Every Mercedes-related visible row is examined, not every query Google recorded.

Pages are separate dimension rows. A Mercedes URL can receive queries not mentioning Mercedes and a non-Mercedes URL can rank for a Mercedes query. Do not add query and page totals or join them as measured pairs.
Devices and Countries are unfiltered sitewide dimensions. They do not give Mercedes-only mobile/desktop or UAE metrics and cannot support per-Mercedes-device conclusions.

No query+page, query+device or query+country cross-tab exists. Cannibalization is not demonstrated by separate Queries and Pages tabs. Need query/page/day/device/country paired export and URL Inspection.

Historical raw exports are accessible but none provides a same-filter 28- or 90-day window ending 2026-10-24. Existing Last 3 months exports contain 92 days, not exactly 90. Do not label them latest 90 days or infer decline.
A seven-day snapshot does not establish ranking decline. No conversions, qualified leads, calls, WhatsApp clicks or revenue are present.
